description: Returns the Cross + Covenant daily devotional for a date: a scripture passage in the World English Bible or King James Version, a short reflection, and a prayer. Defaults to today in Mountain Time. On a date without a devotional available here, returns that day's scripture instead.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to today in Mountain Time.

title: Get the devotional
